integracion_backend.adaptador: src-tauri/src/tools/reverse/decomp/rex_kosinski.rs — mapeo 1:1 de KosError/EncError ao CodecError { code, detail } do contrato de codecs (truncated/invalid_reference/excessive_output/work_limit/empty_input; stream_limit/work_limit), preserving bytes_consumed coa regra do contrato v1 §3 (o padding post-terminator non se consume).
